messages.author: 9200604095b5425e
messages.subject: Proxy question
parts:
I'm configuring an Apache2 reverse proxy in front of a shiny server. I've followed the rstudio proxy example as a starting point.

The rstudio is working fine.  The shiny application will load the non-interactive parts but for the 01_hello example, the histogram will not update. This happens for all the examples.

The shiny server config is all default settings on port 3838.

This is running on a Ubuntu 12 LTS server.

The /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/default for the HTTP settings include a redirect as follows that appears to work. I'm forcing all activity to the SSL side.

        RewriteEngine On
        RewriteCond %{HTTPS} off
        RewriteRule (.*) https://%{HTTP_HOST}%{REQUEST_URI} [R]

The /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/default-ssl for HTTPS has the following added:

        <Proxy *>
                Order deny,allow
                Allow from all
        </Proxy>

        RedirectMatch permanent ^/rstudio$ /rstudio/
        <Location /rstudio/>
                ProxyPass        http://localhost:8787/
                ProxyPassReverse http://localhost:8787/
        </Location>

        RedirectMatch permanent ^/shiny$ /shiny/
        <Location /shiny/>
                ProxyPass        http://localhost:3838/
                ProxyPassReverse http://localhost:3838/
        </Location>

PreserveHost breaks RStudio if enabled.

I can confirm the shiny applications work if I hit them directly on localhost on port 3838. They fail in the above redirected proxied state as stated above.

If someone sees something I've missed or any pointers at thing I should look at, I'd appreciate the help.

Thanks.

Michael
